name: Idaho Livin
old_description: Washed graphic tees and fleece shorts for hot days on the water.
about:
Idaho Livin was founded in 2017 in Boise, Idaho. The company operates from the Clearwater Building in downtown Boise, where it maintains a retail storefront open seven days a week. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, prints, and sells a range of apparel including graphic tees, fleece shorts, hats, and hoodies. All products are described as designed and printed in Idaho. The operation fulfills online orders with next-business-day shipping from Boise and serves over 17,000 customers since launch. It also offers custom apparel services for businesses and organizations.

Idaho Livin serves both direct consumers through its retail and e-commerce channels and business clients seeking custom branded apparel. Its product line leans toward outdoor and lifestyle themes, with designs referencing Idaho landmarks such as the Sawtooth Mountains and the City of Trees.

The brand emphasizes local production and quick turnaround, promoting that every hat, tee, and hoodie is designed and printed in Idaho and that stocked items ship the next business day.
